decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records that internal links must be added before publication; no additional change is required.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records the requirement to add blog images before publication; no additional change is required.
Requiring images and internal links before publication does not change the selected blog keywords.
The publication prerequisite does not change the workflow for providing blog topic suggestions.
The blog publication condition does not alter the campaign keyword count, delivery window, or selected replacement keyword.
The condition for publishing blog articles does not affect backlink quantity or link-type percentages.
The source decision concerns blog publication prerequisites and does not change the requested webpage replacement text.
Adding images to blog articles before publication does not entail any change to ALT attributes for website images.
The blog publication condition does not change the requirement to include keyword search-volume data.
